F2-L03.intro: Ask and give ages — كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ / كَمْ عُمْرُكِ؟ — with عُمْرِي … سَنَةً for 11–20 and … سَنَوَاتٍ for 3–10, then talk about the ages of family and friends.

tasks.examiner: … التَّمْرِينُ لِلْأَعْمَارِ مِنْ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ إِلَى خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.task: ASK which ages the training is for (the coach then answers).
tasks.en: Which age is this training for?

tasks.examiner: هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَخُوكَ أَنْ يَلْعَبَ مَعَنَا؟
tasks.model: لَا، هُوَ صَغِيرٌ؛ عُمْرُهُ عَشْرُ سَنَوَاتٍ فَقَطْ.
tasks.en: No, he is young; he is only ten.

tasks.task: Thank her and wish her a happy birthday (to a girl).
tasks.model: شُكْرًا! كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْرٍ يَا مَرْيَمُ!
tasks.en: Thank you! Happy birthday, Maryam! (lit. every year may you be well)

tasks.task: ASK how old she is today — to a girl (she then answers).
tasks.en: How old are you today? (to a girl)

tasks.task: Give your age and your sister’s age.
tasks.model: عُمْرِي أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.en: I am fourteen, and my sister is eleven.

tasks.task: Give Khalid’s age and one more detail.
tasks.model: عُمْرُهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهُوَ فِي صَفِّي.
tasks.en: He is fifteen, and he is in my class.
My father is forty years old.

roleplays.setting: Signing up at the sports centre
roleplays.title: You and your family

tasks.task: Give your name and age (16) in one sentence.
tasks.model: اِسْمِي يُوسُفُ، وَعُمْرِي سِتَّ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.en: My name is Yusuf, and I am sixteen.

tasks.task: Say who you have and give both ages (18 and 12).
tasks.help: نَعَمْ، عِنْدِي … ؛ عُمْرُ أَخِي … ، وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي …
tasks.model: نَعَمْ، عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ؛ عُمْرُ أَخِي ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
tasks.en: Yes, I have a brother and a sister; my brother is eighteen and my sister is twelve.

tasks.task: Say your sister wants to join too, and why.
tasks.model: أُخْتِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَشْتَرِكَ أَيْضًا، لِأَنَّهَا تُحِبُّ السِّبَاحَةَ.
tasks.en: My sister wants to join too, because she loves swimming.

tasks.examiner: … نَعَمْ، النَّادِي لِلْأَعْمَارِ مِنِ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً إِلَى عِشْرِينَ.
tasks.task: ASK if your sister’s age is suitable (the receptionist then answers).
tasks.en: Is my sister’s age suitable for the club?

tasks.examiner: كَمْ عُمْرُ أَصْغَرِ شَخْصٍ فِي أُسْرَتِكَ؟
tasks.model: أَصْغَرُ شَخْصٍ هُوَ أَخِي الصَّغِيرُ؛ عُمْرُهُ خَمْسُ سَنَوَاتٍ فَقَطْ.
tasks.en: The youngest is my little brother; he is only five.

conversation.qen: How do you ask a girl her age?
conversation.en: How old are you? (to a girl)

conversation.qen: How old is your sister or brother?
What is your name, and how old are you?
conversation.model: اِسْمِي سَارَةُ، وَعُمْرِي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
conversation.en: My name is Sara, and I am thirteen.

conversation.qen: Introduce a male friend: name and age.
conversation.model: هٰذَا صَدِيقِي يُوسُفُ، وَعُمْرُهُ سِتَّ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
conversation.en: This is my friend Yusuf, and he is sixteen.

conversation.qen: Introduce a female friend: name and age.
conversation.model: هٰذِهِ صَدِيقَتِي زَيْنَبُ، وَعُمْرُهَا اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
conversation.en: This is my friend Zaynab, and she is twelve.

conversation.qen: How old are your brothers and sisters?
conversation.model: عُمْرُ أَخِي سَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي تِسْعُ سَنَوَاتٍ.
conversation.en: My brother is seventeen, and my sister is nine.

conversation.qen: When do we say “sanawāt” and when “sanatan”?
conversation.starter: مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ إِلَى عَشْرٍ نَقُولُ «…»، مِثْلَ … وَمِنْ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ نَقُولُ «…»
conversation.model: مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ إِلَى عَشْرٍ نَقُولُ «سَنَوَاتٍ»، مِثْلَ «خَمْسُ سَنَوَاتٍ»، وَمِنْ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ إِلَى عِشْرِينَ نَقُولُ «سَنَةً»، مِثْلَ «خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً».
conversation.en: From three to ten we say “sanawāt”, like “five years”, and from eleven to twenty we say “sanatan”, like “fifteen years”.

conversation.qen: Introduce your family with their ages.
conversation.starter: فِي أُسْرَتِي … : … عُمْرُ أَخِي … وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي … وَأَنَا عُمْرِي …
conversation.model: فِي أُسْرَتِي خَمْسَةُ أَشْخَاصٍ: أَبِي وَأُمِّي وَأَخِي وَأُخْتِي وَأَنَا. عُمْرُ أَخِي عِشْرُونَ سَنَةً، وَعُمْرُ أُخْتِي عَشْرُ سَنَوَاتٍ، وَأَنَا عُمْرِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
conversation.en: There are five people in my family: my father, mother, brother, sister and me. My brother is twenty, my sister is ten, and I am fifteen.

conversation.qen: How old are the students in your class?
conversation.model: أَغْلَبُ الطُّلَّابِ فِي صَفِّي عُمْرُهُمْ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَبَعْضُهُمْ عُمْرُهُمْ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
conversation.en: Most students in my class are fourteen, and some are fifteen.

conversation.q: كَمْ سَيَكُونُ عُمْرُكَ فِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ؟
conversation.qen: How old will you be next year?
conversation.starter: فِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ سَيَكُونُ عُمْرِي … ، وَسَأَكُونُ …
conversation.model: فِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ سَيَكُونُ عُمْرِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَسَأَكُونُ فِي الصَّفِّ الحَادِيَ عَشَرَ.
conversation.en: Next year I will be fifteen, and I will be in Year 11.
